=Prompt:

Act as an expert financial researcher. Using only Yahoo Finance, Perplexity Finance, officially listed exchange websites, and financial regulators, research and report the following for each entity in the input JSON array:

sharesOutstanding

marketCap (maximum precision)

ipoDate

ceo

sector

industry

Include all input fields with the output for seamless downstream processing. Each record returned must also include an array of sources, reported in a field named aisources.

Research Input:
json

{{ JSON.stringify($json.body) }}


Expected Output Format:

json
[
  {
    "cik": 1045810,
    "name": "NVIDIA CORP",
    "ticker": "NVDA",
    "exchangename": "Nasdaq",
    "sharesOutstanding": "<number>",
    "marketCap": "<decimal>",
    "ipoDate": "<YYYY-MM-DD>",
    "ceo": "<string>",
    "sector": "<string>",
    "industry": "<string>",
    "aisources": ["<source1>", "<source2>", ...]
  },
  // repeat for each company
] 
No explanation. Output only minified JSON array .Provide the most recent and accurate information for each field, and cite all sources used from the allowed list in the "aisources" array. Please do not add anything, including explaination,  more than the json structure specified above.
